title: Started Work on New Car
summary: The team has kicked off development of our next-generation car platform. Initial CAD and concept work began on June 1.

title: Acquired New Sponsors
summary: We have secured an additional sponsor, ITSS, to strengthen our manufacturing and outreach efforts. Welcome aboard to all new partners.

title: Finalizing the Rear Wing Assembly
summary: Today we completed the third iteration of our rear wing assembly. Using CFD analysis, we've managed to reduce drag by 4% while maintaining the necessary downforce for tight corners.

title: New Sponsorship Partnership Announced
summary: We are thrilled to welcome our newest Gold Tier sponsor. This partnership will provide the resources needed for our advanced carbon fiber manufacturing process.

title: Preparation for Regional Qualifiers
summary: The team is working around the clock to finalize the car for the upcoming Delhi NCR Regional Qualifiers. Testing phase has officially begun.
